pages.title: Cookie Jar
pages.text: Open the jar and fill its eight inventory slots. Each visible cookie represents an occupied slot. Opening the menu gives a one-second redstone pulse, even through an adjacent solid block.
Keep the jar within reach if you want to use it as a redstone trigger.

pages.title: Dinner Plate
pages.text: Right-click with food to serve it into one of three slots. Sneak-right-click empty-handed to open the menu. When hungry, right-click a served plate four times to finish a portion. Bowls and other containers are returned when appropriate.
The plate shows either one or three food piles as you fill it.
